01 / THE PROTOCOLA COMMON INTERFACE

An open protocol
for physical ecash.

Cashu Card defines how a wallet, a payment terminal and an NFC card work together.

The card stores Cashu proofs and signs payment authorizations. Wallets handle holder setup and top-ups. Terminals exchange payment messages with the card and submit proofs to the mint for settlement.

Read the protocol specification ↗
01

Shared wire format

One documented APDU interface for independent implementations to build against.

02

Holder-controlled setup

The holder’s wallet keeps the owner key used to administer their card and its settings.

01

Current status

Cashu Card is a draft protocol with a version 2.1 reference implementation. The card proposal is being developed separately from the published Cashu NUTs.

02

Security and settlement

Card authorization and mint settlement are separate steps. Mints redeem the ecash; accepting a payment offline carries settlement risk. Review the security model and hardware reports for your intended deployment.

Read the security model ↗
